## Mach One description (Radium's website, as pasted by the repo owner)

> Radium's R6 Trucks were born out of a relentless pursuit of stability, especially at high
> speeds. [...] That's why the R6 Trucks feature a 30 degree angle in the rear truck, providing
> rock-solid stability even when pushing the limits of speed.

Source URL: not recorded.

## R6 pre-order listing (as quoted on the esk8.news forum)

> 60 degree front, 30 degree rear pivot angle

- Quoted in a post by forum user "rusins", 2023-06-25, in
  https://forum.esk8.news/t/radium-r6-trucks-thane-belts/77112
- The original listing, https://radium-performance.com/products/radium-prototype-trucks-pre-order,
  returned 404 on 2026-10-17.
- This was a pre-order of prototype trucks, so the production front truck may differ.
